gate: src43 — the finite exceptional prime problem, computed

P_red.bounded_by: Mazur's theorem — the only possible prime degrees

rows.how: sieve structurally vacuous (every element of F2 is a square); settled by X_0(2), RUN-007

P_red.why_universal: Mazur's theorem makes the twelve exhaustive, so refuting all twelve empties the set for every prime, not up to a bound

P_ram.documents_own_warning: 此式只能作 compiler heuristic，不能直接當 theorem
P_ram.what_the_formula_lacks: a term for the `ell != p` clause. It models the ramification condition and not the requirement that the witness be a different prime, which is what bites at a singleton W_-

P_loc.what_is_claimed: that the set has not stopped below 6,000. Whether it is infinite is Lang–Trotter's heuristic and is not claimed here
P_loc.criterion: a_p(E)^2 = 1 (mod p), from 10, exact for good ordinary p

success_criterion.criterion: p not in P_red ∪ P_loc ∪ P_ram  =>  FW(E, p), with all three finite, effectively computable and certificate-producing
success_criterion.why: P_loc is non-empty and not known finite, so the mother problem's finite certificate is not obtained for all odd p by this route

the_routing_answer.why_disjoint: P_loc is defined by a_p^2 = 1 mod p at ORDINARY primes, and the FW branch is the SUPERSINGULAR ones; a prime cannot be both
the_routing_answer.reading: 04's mother problem is not solved for all odd p, and the family theorem does not need it to be: the primes that block it are routed to the ordinary theorem by 12's P2, never to FW

degradation_rule.rule: 不得用「tested up to B」替代全稱量詞

P_red.licensed_by: Mazur's theorem makes twelve degrees exhaustive; all twelve refuted

P_ram_formula.licensed_by: v_29(Δ) = 1 has no prime divisors at all
P_ram_formula.but: the formula is a heuristic, and the true obstruction is [29]

P_loc.claim: 8 members below 6000, and it has not stopped

headline: all three of `04`'s sets are now computed for 696.e1: P_red empty and universally so, P_ram's formula empty but the formula a heuristic whose exact failure RUN-037 found, and P_loc non-empty and not stopped. The mother problem is NOT solved for all odd p, and the family theorem does not need it to be — the blocking primes are ordinary, and the corpus's own router never asks FW for those
